notes:
MOD-010 builds Layercake.silv_event_amount (PK event_nk; CK on the six RULE-088 amount_status values; indexes on (contact_no, amount_campaign_year) and invoice_rec_id; created_at/updated_at default SYSDATETIME()) and Layercake.usp_load_silv_event_amount @run_id uniqueidentifier = NULL, logged as usp_etl_log_start @run_id, 'silver', 'silv_event_amount'. Starting point: all 37 test_MOD010 tests failed (table missing); now 37/37 plus 6 test_MOD010_dev pass, round-trip and check pass.
Behaviour: amount Campaign Year = own year, a Join's = MIN(campaign_year) of the contact in silv_payment_events, else its own (RULE-032 read literally, so a paid year before the Join's own year is used: pinned by a dev test). Amount event per contact and amount year: Readmission, Renewal, Join, earliest event_date, lowest event_id; it takes brnz_subs_status.inv_total_amount (live row) cast to decimal(19,4), into both amount columns; an overflowing value fails the load (8115), logs Failed and changes nothing. amount_status follows RULE-088 in order. Invoice match (from 2022, eligible invoices from vw_silv_eligible_invoice of the amount year): events that get an invoice are those ranked within the invoice count by type priority, event_date, event_nk; they pair in (event_date, event_nk) order with the latest invoices by the view's invoice_seq (trans_date, rec_id). match_outcome: 'Before invoice data' (<2022), 'No eligible invoice', 'Invoice shortfall', 'Matched'. No invoice or line amount is read. Writes only differences (EXCEPT comparison, contact_no and event_type as bytes); a rerun logs 0, 0, 0.
Choice for the Tester: on the shortfall, a tie on type and date goes to the lower event_nk (Q-036's match tie-break), while the amount tie goes to the lowest event_id (Q-047); the two can pick different events (dev test 'shortfall tie on type and date...'). No grants needed for this module.

Test-first: the first run had 0 of 37 of the Tester's tests passing; the final run passed 37 of 37 and 6 unit test(s), in 3 run(s).
